generatedBy: Hand-written for ASSETS/MACHETE.png. Not an analyzer export — this is a single still, not a performance, so there is no grid to read and no sections to cut. Dimensions measured off the PNG header and the ink box by _chromakey/_ayescale.js's sibling probe; rendered isolated as _chromakey/_machete_only.png.
note: THE WEAPON ITSELF, as a world object — the one physical machete that changes owner. One frame, because a dropped blade does not animate: where it lies and which way it points are position and rotation, not art. Ink box is 2055x374 of the 2113x744 canvas, at (26,215); the loader crops to that union automatically, so the padding costs nothing. BLADE POINTS LEFT, handle on the right, which matches the facing of every sheet on this character — so a machete drawn unflipped agrees with an Aye drawn unflipped, and the same flip rule (`facing !== faces`) serves both. The red wrapped grip is the same red that reads as ~1.2% of every frame of his attack sheet, which is how the two were confirmed to be the same prop. NOT YET LOADED by loadWorld: nothing draws it until the weapon entity exists (spec stages 5-6), and adding an unused 0.8 MB sheet to every level load buys nothing. The sheet config is defined in game.js so the measurements live with the rest of them.
